μὴ: μή — not; negative in wishes, prohibitions and purpose clauses (’lest, that not’) · also in a conditional clause + subj.: ’if not’ · also in a conditional clause + opt.: εἰ μὴ … μνησαίαθ’ ’unless … were to call to mind’ · also εἰ μὴ with an aor. indic., past unreal condition: ’had not’ (εἰ μὴ … ἐξήγγειλεν ’had not … told’) · also μὴ μέν + fut. indic., introducing the content of an oath: ’that … not’ (μὴ μὲν … ἐποχήσεται ’that no other man will ride’) · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’) · also the negative of an infinitive in a reported threat: ’not to’ (μὴ πρίν … ἀπονέεσθαι ’not to go back until’) · also μή + pres. indic. after an oath, introducing its content: ’that … not’ (μὴ … πημαίνει ’that he does not harm’) · also the negative of an infinitive used as a command: ’and not to’ (μὴ δὲ … εἶναι ’and do not be’) · also μὴ μέν + aor. indic., introducing the content of an oath: ’that … never’ (μὴ μὲν … χεῖρ’ ἐπένεικα ’that I never laid a hand’)
νέεσθαι: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεῖσθαι)
νέμονται: νέμω — mid. graze, feed on, range over; pres. 3 pl. mid.: ’they graze’
νεφεληγερέτα: νεφεληγερέτα — epithet of Zeus: ’cloud-gatherer’ (νεφέλη ’cloud’ + ἀγείρω ’gather’); masc. nom. sg., old -α form
νεφεληγερέταο: νεφεληγερέτης — cloud-gatherer, epithet of Zeus; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
νεῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl. (= epic νηῶν)
νηυσὶ: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί)
νόος: νόος — mind, purpose; masc. nom. sg. (= Attic νοῦς)
νῆες: ναῦς — ship; fem. nom. pl. νῆες
ξάνθον: Ξάνθος — Xanthus (’chestnut’), one of Achilles’ immortal horses; masc. acc. sg.
ξεστῇς: ξεστός — polished, smoothed; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇς (= Attic ξεσταῖς)
οἰκία: οἰκίον — house, home (Homer has only neut. pl. οἰκία, collective, = Attic οἰκία fem. sg.); neut. acc. pl.
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἱ ἄριστοι ’the best men’) · also enclitic dat. sg. pron. for a thing: ’on it, to it’ (ἐν δέ οἱ ἧλοι ’and on it studs’)
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἳ θάμνοι ’the bushes’) · also masc. nom. pl. in the correlative οἳ μὲν … οἳ δέ: ’some … others’
οἶος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg. · also οἶος printed for οἰός (οἶς) — sheep; gen. sg. οἰός: ’of a sheep’ (οἰὸς ἄωτος ’sheep’s wool’)
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐλύμποιο: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus; gen. sg., epic Οὐ- lengthening and genitive in -οιο (= Attic Ὀλύμπου)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὔτέ: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj., accented οὔτέ before an enclitic
οὕνεκ: οὕνεκα — because, for that reason; conj., elided (οὕνεκ’ = οὕνεκα) · also ’that’, introducing what was learned (πεύθετο … οὕνεκ’ … ἔμελλον ’learned that they were about to’)
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάντῃ: πάντῃ — everywhere, in every direction; adv. (dat. fem. of πᾶς)
πάρα: παρά — beside, at hand; adv. with the accent drawn back (anastrophe) before a form of εἰμί: πάρα … εἰσι = πάρεισι ’are at hand’ · also πάρα = πάρεστι ’is at hand’, with ellipsis of the verb (τῷ … πάρα εἷς γε θεῶν ’beside him is one of the gods’) · also prep. + gen., accent drawn back after its noun (anastrophe): ’from beside, from’ (γαμβροῖο πάρα ’from his son-in-law’) · also prep. + dat., accent drawn back after its noun (anastrophe): ’by, beside’ (νηῒ πάρα ’by the ship’) · also prep. + acc., accent drawn back after its noun (anastrophe): ’beside’ (ποταμὸν πάρα ’beside the river’)
πέτετ: πέτομαι — fly, speed; impf. 3 sg. mid. dep., elided and unaugmented (πέτετ’ = ἐπέτετο): ’flew, sped’
πήδασον: Πήδασος — Pedasus, a Trojan, son of Bucolion; masc. acc. sg. · also Pedasus, a town on the Satnioeis; fem. acc. sg. · also Pedasus, a horse of Achilles, the trace-horse; masc. acc. sg.
παλλὰς: Παλλάς — Pallas, a title of Athena; fem. nom. sg.
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; + dat./acc./gen. · also adv., ’beside (him)’ (παρὰ δὲ … Ἥρη ’and beside him Hera’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρὰ … βάλλετ’ = παραβάλλετε ’set beside’)
πεδίοιο: πεδίον — plain; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), gen. of the space traversed: ’over the plain’ · also neut. gen. sg., dependent on a noun: ’of the plain’ · also neut. gen. sg., of separation after ἐκ: ’from the plain’ (ἐκ πεδίοιο)
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’) · also adv. ’beyond others’ with the dat. of respect: ’by far’ (περὶ ἔγχει … φέρτατος ’best by far with the spear’) · also prep. + dat., of concern: ’for, over’ (περὶ ξανθῷ Μενελάῳ ’for fair-haired Menelaus’) · also prep. + acc. of the thing contended for: ’over’ (περὶ τεύχε’ ’over the armour’) · also + gen. with λείπομαι: ’left over from’ (πολέμοιο περὶ … λίπωνται ’are left over from the war’)
πευκαλίμῃσι: πευκαλίμος — keen, sharp, piercing; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς), agreeing with φρεσί
πηλέος: Πηλεύς — Peleus, father of Achilles; masc. gen. sg., epic -έος (= Attic -έως)
πηλεΐδεω: Πηλεΐδης — son of Peleus (Achilles); masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic Πηλείδου)
πηλεΐωνα: Πηλεΐων — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles; masc. acc. sg., patronymic
πηλεΐωνος: Πηλεΐων — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles; masc. gen. sg., patronymic
ποίησεν: ποιέω — make, build; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐποίησεν)
ποδώκεα: ποδώκης — swift-footed (πούς + ὠκύς); masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic -η)
ποδώκεος: ποδώκης — swift-footed (πούς + ὠκύς); masc. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
πολέμου: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., after ἀποπαύεο: ’from war’ · also gen. sg. of separation after ἐκ: ’out of the war’ · also masc. gen. sg., after ἄτερ: ’without war’ · also masc. gen. sg., after εἶκε: ’from war’ (εἶκε … πολέμου ’withdraw from war’) · also masc. gen. sg. of separation after ἀφεξόμεθ’: ’from war’ · also masc. gen. sg., after ἔραται: ’for war’ (πολέμου ἔραται ’loves war’) · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of respect after ἀκορήτω: ’insatiate of war’ · also masc. gen. sg. after ἤ, dependent on ἔρον: ’than (desire) for war’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on ἐρωή: ’(respite) from war’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on τέλος: ’of war’ (τέλος πολέμου ’the outcome of war’) · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on ὀαριστύς: ’of war’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on στόμα: ’of war’ (πολέμου στόμα ’the mouth of war’)
πολεμιστήν: πολεμιστής — warrior, fighter; masc. acc. sg.
πολυπίδακος: πολυπίδαξ — many-springed, rich in springs; fem. gen. sg., epithet of Ida
πολυπτύχου: πολύπτυχος — many-folded, with many ridges and glens; masc. gen. sg., epithet of Olympus
ποσειδάων: Ποσειδάων — Poseidon, god of the sea; masc. nom. sg. (= Attic Ποσειδῶν)
ποσειδάωνος: Ποσειδῶν — Poseidon; gen. sg., epic uncontracted (Attic Ποσειδῶνος)
ποῦ: ποῦ — where?; interrog. adv., in a direct question
πραπίδεσσιν: πραπίδες — wits, mind, understanding (origin uncertain; plural only); fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= -εσι)
πριάμοιο: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πριαμίδη: Πριαμίδης — son of Priam, patronymic; masc. voc. sg., in address
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
πρόσθεν: πρόσθεν — before, formerly; adv. · also prep. + gen., ’in front of’ (πρόσθεν ἕθεν ’in front of him’)
πρὶν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv./conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’) · also adv., ’besides’ (πρὸς δ’ … ῥῆξε ’and besides … broke’) · also prep. + dat.: ’on, against’ (πρὸς χρυσῇ περόνῃ ’on a golden brooch’) · also + gen. of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς ἁλός ’toward the sea’) · also in πρὸς ἰθύ ’straight toward’, with ἰθύ adverbial · also + acc., ’against’ (πρὸς δαίμονα ’against a divinity’)
πρῶτα: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first’
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’ · also masc. acc. sg., of an arrow: ’winged’
πόλεμον: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
πόλεμός: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. nom. sg. (accented before an enclitic)
πόλιος: πόλις — city; fem. gen. sg., epic (= Attic πόλεως)
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, grave before another word) — beside, alongside; prep. + dat.: ’beside’ · also prep. + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ ποταμὸν ’beside the river’) · also prep. + gen., ’from beside’ (πὰρ Διὸς ’from Zeus’) · also adverb, ’beside him’ · also adverb, no case: ’beside, alongside’ (πὰρ δὲ … ἕστασαν ’and beside … stood’) · also prep. + gen., ’by, beside’ (πὰρ ποταμοῖο ’by the river’) · also prep. + acc., ’beyond’ (πὰρ δύναμιν ’beyond one’s power’)
σθένεϊ: σθένος — strength, might; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic σθένει): ’in strength’
σκάμανδρον: Σκάμανδρος — Scamander, the river of Troy; masc. acc. sg.
στήθεσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl.
στήσομαι: ἵστημι — set, stand; mid. take one’s stand; fut. 1 sg. mid.: ’I shall take my stand’
στυγέουσι: στυγέω — hate, abhor; pres. 3 pl. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic στυγοῦσι): ’they hate’
στᾶσ: ἵστημι — set; aor. ἔστην, intrans., take one’s stand; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (στᾶσ’ = στᾶσα): ’having taken her stand’
σύμβαλον: συμβάλλω — throw together, clash; aor. 3 pl. act., unaugmented, epic (= Attic συνέβαλον): ’clashed, came together’
σὲ: σύ — you (sg.); acc. sg., subject of an infinitive: ’you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἀνῆκεν: ’you’ · also acc. sg., of the person in need, with χρεώ: ’(need of) you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἐπιδωσόμεθ’: ’you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἔδονται: ’you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἀμφί: ’around you’
σῶκος: Σῶκος — Socus, a Trojan, son of Hippasus; masc. nom. sg., proper name
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl., ’those things’; accented before an enclitic · also relative, neut. nom. pl.: ’which’ (τά τ’ αἰδῶ ἀμφικαλύπτει ’which cover the shame’) · also neut. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τά τε δῶρ’ Ἀφροδίτης ’and the gifts of Aphrodite’) · also relative, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ (τά οἵ ποτε … πόρε ’which he once gave him’)
τάφρον: τάφρος — trench, ditch; fem. acc. sg.
τέλος: τέλος — end, fulfilment, outcome; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., as object (τέλος πολέμοιο κιχείω ’I find the end of the war’) · also neut. acc. sg. with the -δε of direction (τέλος δέ ’to the end’) · also neut. acc. sg. after ἐς, a body of men: ’company’ (ἐς … τέλος ’to the company’) · also neut. acc. sg. after ἐπί, a body of men: ’company’ (ἐπὶ … τέλος)
τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’) · also neut. nom. sg. agreeing with ἔγχος after εἴ: ’any’ (εἴ τί τοι ἔγχος ’if any spear of yours’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κῆδος after εἴ: ’some’ (εἴ πέρ τί σε κῆδος ἱκάνει ’if some concern reaches you’) · also neut. acc. sg. indefinite, agreeing with ἔπος: ’some (word)’
τίθει: τίθημι — put, place, set; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐτίθει) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’put, give!’
τίπτ: τίπτε (= τί ποτε) — why ever, why then; interrog. adv., elided (τίπτ’ = τίπτε)
ταλαύρινον: ταλαύρινος — shield-enduring (τλῆναι + ῥινός; sense traditional), a standing epithet of Ares; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. (or nom.), predicate of the hide shield with πολεμίζειν: ’shield-enduring’ (τό μοι ἔστι ταλαύρινον πολεμίζειν)
ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τείχεος: τεῖχος — wall; neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -εος (= Attic τείχους)
τεύχεσι: τεῦχος — (pl.) armour, gear; neut. dat. pl.
τεῖος: τεῖος — meanwhile, for the time being; adv., epic (= Attic τέως)
τεῖχος: τεῖχος — wall; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’wall’
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’) · also adverbial acc. after μήτε: ’at all’ (μήτέ τι νείκει ’nor find fault at all’) · also adverbial acc. with a comparative: ’somewhat’ (τι … ἄμεινον ’somewhat better’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with σπέος: ’a certain’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄφελος: ’some’ (ὄφελός τι ’some use’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἠέ: ’at all’ (ἠέ τι βέβληαι ’have you been hit at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object after εἰ: ’anything’ (εἴ τι … ῥέξει ’if … will do anything’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἦ ἄρ: ’at all, in any way’ (ἦ ἄρ τι … ἄρειον ’was it in any way better?’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also masc. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους ’the others’) · also masc. acc. pl. in the correlative τοὺς μέν … τοὺς δέ: ’some … others’
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ, temporal: ’from that time’ · also masc. gen. sg., ’the other’, after πρό (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it, its’ (τοῦ δέκα οἶμοι ’ten bands of it’) · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of comparison: ’than he, than him’ (after ἀμείνων) · also masc. gen. sg., of separation, with ἀπέσσεσθαι: ’from it, from him’ · also neut. gen. sg. standing for a thing, of separation after ἀπάνευθε: ’away from it’
τρόμος: τρόμος — trembling, quaking; masc. nom. sg.
τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τρῶας: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. acc. pl.
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Trojans!’
τόσσος: τόσος — so great, so much; masc. nom. sg., epic τόσσος (= Attic τοσοῦτος)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. acc. sg. as antecedent of a relative: ’the man (who)’ (τὸν μὲν … ὅς κε ’the man who’)
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’ · also dual nom. with a noun, article-like: ’the two’ (τὼ … ὄσσε ’his two eyes’)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’ · also gen. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τῶν ἄλλων Τρώων ’the other Trojans’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’) · also neut. dat. sg., ’in it’ (ἐν τῷ … κύκησε ’in it mixed’, of a cup) · also masc. dat. sg. with a participle: ’upon him (as he drew)’ (ἐπὶ τῷ ἐρύοντι) · also neut. dat. sg., demonstrative before a relative: ’that’ (τῷ ἴκελον οἷον ’like that which’)
υἱέϊ: υἱός — son; masc. dat. sg., epic υἱέϊ (= Attic υἱεῖ)
φάος: φάος — light (epic uncontracted = Attic φῶς); neut. nom./acc. sg.
φοῖβος: Φοῖβος — Phoebus, epithet of Apollo (‘bright, radiant’); masc. nom. sg.
φρένα: φρήν — mind, wits, heart; fem. acc. sg.
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φωνήν: φωνή — voice, sound; fem. acc. sg.
χαλκείῳ: χάλκειος — of bronze, bronze-tipped; masc./neut. dat. sg.
χροὸς: χρώς — skin, flesh; masc. gen. sg., epic χροός (= Attic χρωτός)
χωλεύων: χωλεύω — limp, be lame; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
ἀΰτει: ἀΰτέω — call out, shout; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, contracted -εε → -ει (= Attic ἠΰτει): ’called to’
ἀγορὴν: ἀγορή — assembly, gathering place; acc. sg. (Ionic for Attic ἀγορά)
ἀγῶνα: ἀγών — gathering, assembly; masc. acc. sg.
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθήνης: Ἀθήνη — Athena; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic Ἀθηνᾶς)
ἀθανάτοισι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἀκροτάτης: ἄκρος — topmost, highest; superl. ἀκρότατος, fem. gen. sg., agreeing with κόρυθος: ’the very top (of the helmet)’
ἀλίαστον: ἀλίαστος — unceasing, relentless (rare; sense traditional); adj., acc. sg.
ἀλεγεινῆς: ἀλεγεινός — painful, grievous; adj., fem. gen. sg.
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀμφοτέροισι: ἀμφότερος — both (of two); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), after μετά: ’among both’ · also masc. dat. pl., indirect object of ὄπασσον: ’to both’ · also masc. dat. pl., instrumental, agreeing with ποσσίν: ’(with) both (feet)’ · also masc. dat. pl. after ἐπί: ’over both’ (ἐπ’ ἀμφοτέροισι τάνυσσαν ’stretched over both’)

ἀμύνει: ἀμύνω — ward off, keep away; pres. 3 sg. act., + acc.: ’wards off’ · also + gen. of the one protected: ’defends, wards off harm from’ (παιδὸς ἀμύνει)
ἀνδρομέοιο: ἀνδρόμεος — of a man, human; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with a noun
ἀνώγει: ἄνωγα (perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’was bidding’ · also pres. 3 sg., paired with ἐποτρύνει: ’bids’
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen. · also a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀπ’ … ὀμόργνυ = ἀπομόργνυ ’wiped off’) · also with a form in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπ’ αὐτόφιν ’from it’)
ἀπάνευθε: ἀπάνευθε — far away, apart, at a distance; adv., + gen.
ἀπέην: ἄπειμι — be away, be distant; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἀπῆν): ’he was away’
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀπειλαὶ: ἀπειλή — threat, boast; fem. nom. pl.
ἀπολήγει: ἀπολήγω — leave off, cease, come to an end; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’ends’
ἀραιαί: ἀραιός — thin, slender; fem. nom. pl.
ἀργικέραυνε: ἀργικέραυνος — of the flashing thunderbolt; masc. voc. sg., epithet of Zeus
ἀφροδίτη: Ἀφροδίτη — Aphrodite, goddess of love; fem. nom. sg.
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.

ἀχιλῆος: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. gen. sg., single-λ epic (= Attic Ἀχιλλέως)
ἁλὸς: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. gen. sg. · also ἅλς (masc.) — salt; masc. gen. sg., partitive: ’of salt’
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also modal particle ἄν after ἐπεί + subj.: ’once’ (ἐπεὶ ἂν … ἐπίσπῃς ’once you have met’) · also modal particle with the subj. in a general relative clause: ’whomever’ (ὃν … ἂν … νοήσω ’whomever I notice’) · also modal particle ἄν with an infinitive in reported speech, keeping the ’would’ of the direct words: ’he said he would’ (ἂν … ἔφη παραμυθήσασθαι) · also ἂν = ἀνά before ν, prep. + acc.: ’up through’ (ἂν νέκυας ’up through the corpses’) · also with ὡς + subj. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν … τιμήσομεν ’so that we may honour’)
ἃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. pl.: ’which’
ἄγχιστα: ἄγχι — near; superl. adv. ἄγχιστα: ’nearest, most closely’
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’(you) other (gods)’ (Ζεῦ ἄλλοι τε θεοί)
ἄλλοτ: ἄλλοτε — at another time, at other times; adv., elided (ἄλλοτ’); καὶ ἄλλοτ’ ’at another time too’
ἄλλοτε: ἄλλοτε — at another time, at one time … at another; adv.
ἄλλως: ἄλλως — otherwise, in another way; adv.
ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ἄντ: ἄντα — opposite, face to face; adv./prep. + gen., elided (ἄντ’ = ἄντα): ’straight at’
ἄντα: ἄντα — opposite, facing; adv. · also prep. + gen., ’opposite, over against’, following its noun
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄρηα: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρη) · also by metonymy ’war’ (πολύδακρυν Ἄρηα ’tearful war’)
ἄρης: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. nom. sg.
ἄρηϊ: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρει)
ἄρτεμις: Ἄρτεμις — Artemis, goddess of the hunt and of sudden painless death (esp. of women); fem. nom. sg.
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time, along; adv./prep. + dat.
ἅμα: ἅμα — together, at the same time; adv. · also prep. + dat.: ’together with’
ἆλτο: ἅλλομαι — leap, spring; aor. 3 sg. mid., athematic, epic (= Attic ἥλατο): ’sprang’
ἆσαι: ἄω — glut, satiate (+ gen.); aor. inf. act. ἆσαι: ’to glut’
ἐεισάμενος: εἴδομαι — seem; make oneself like (+ dat.); aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic ἐεισάμενος: ’having likened himself (to)’
ἐθέλοντα: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’(me) though I wish’ · also masc. acc. sg. agreeing with a relative: ’wishing (to hang back)’
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκέλευεν: κελεύω — bid, order, urge; impf. 3 sg., movable ν (= Attic ἐκέλευε(ν)): ’ordered’
ἐκτός: ἐκτός — outside, out of; prep. + gen. (placed after its noun) · also adv., ’outside’
ἐλθόντες: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having come’
ἐμὴν: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. acc. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐναίρειν: ἐναίρω — kill, slay; pres. inf. act., epexegetic after an adjective: ’to slay’
ἐναντίβιον: ἐναντίβιος — face to face, in open opposition; neut. acc. sg. used as an adverb: ’face to face’
ἐναντίον: ἐναντίος — opposite; neut. acc. sg. as adv./prep. + gen.: ’in front of, before’
ἐνοσίχθων: ἐνοσίχθων — earth-shaker, epithet of Poseidon (from ἔνοσις ’shaking’ + χθών ’earth’); masc. nom. sg.
ἐνυαλίοιο: Ἐνυάλιος — Enyalius, the war god, a name of Ares; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἐνῆκε: ἐνίημι — send in, put into; aor. 3 sg. act. (κ-aorist), + acc.: ’put in’
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’) · also in ἐξ αὖτις, adverbial: ’again, once more’
ἐξείρετο: ἐξείρομαι — ask out, inquire of (+ acc.); impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’questioned’
ἐξεφάνη: ἐκφαίνω — show forth; aor. 3 sg. pass., intransitive: ’appeared, came into view’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’) · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (left) side’ (ἐπ’ ἀριστερόφιν ’on the left’) · also + gen., ’on’ (ἐπ’ εὐνάων ’on anchor-stones’)
ἐπέπαυτ: παύω — stop; mid. cease (+ gen.); plpf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἐπέπαυτ’ = ἐπέπαυτο): ’had ceased’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’)
ἐπῶρσε: ἐπόρνυμι — stir up, rouse against; aor. 3 sg., epic (ἐπ- + ὦρσε): ’roused up’
ἐρεμνῇ: ἐρεμνός — dark, black, dusky; fem. dat. sg.
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’) · also + acc. of time: ’until’ (ἐς ἠέλιον καταδύντα ’until sunset’) · also + acc. of purpose: ’for’ (ἐς βρωτύν ’for food’)
ἐτίναξε: τινάσσω — shake, brandish, pluck; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’shook, tugged’
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑκάστου: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. gen. sg.
ἑκάτοιο: ἕκατος — far-darter (epithet of Apollo, probably a short form of ἑκατηβόλος; sense not certain); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἑρμείας: Ἑρμείας — Hermes, epic form of Ἑρμῆς; masc. nom. sg.
ἑτέρωθεν: ἑτέρωθεν — from the other side; adv. with suffix -θεν
ἑταίρου: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. gen. sg., of cause with ἀχνύμενος: ’for the comrade’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on a noun: ’of a companion’ (παραίφασις ἑταίρου ’a companion’s persuasion’) · also masc. gen. sg. after παρά: ’from a companion’ (παρ’ ἑταίρου) · also masc. gen. sg., object of ἀμέλησεν: ’neglect his companion’ · also masc. gen. sg., in a genitive absolute with a participle: ’as the companion called’ (ἑταίρου κικλήσκοντος)
ἔγειρε: ἐγείρω — rouse, wake; 3 sg. aor. or impf. act., unaugmented (= ἤγειρε): ’roused’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’wake!’
ἔγχεϊ: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic ἔγχει)
ἔνδον: ἔνδον — within, inside, at home; adv.
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἔνθ’ ἄρα τε φρένες ἔρχαται ’where the midriff is shut’)
ἔριδα: ἔρις — strife, rivalry, contest; fem. acc. sg. · also Ἔρις — Strife, the goddess; fem. acc. sg.
ἔριδι: ἔρις — strife, quarrel; fem. dat. sg.
ἔρις: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contest; fem. nom. sg. · also Ἔρις — Strife, the goddess; fem. nom. sg.
ἔρχεσθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 pl., elided (ἔρχεσθ’ = ἔρχεσθε): ’go!’ · also pres. inf. mid., elided (ἔρχεσθ’ = ἔρχεσθαι), after φαίης: ’to be going’
ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
ἔστ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., elided (ἔστ’ = ἔστι)
ἔφατο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ἔφη): ’he spoke’
ἔχοντες: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕκαστον: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. acc. sg.: ’each (man)’
ἕκτορος: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam, chief Trojan hero; masc. gen. sg.
ἕνεκα: ἕνεκα — on account of, for the sake of; prep. + gen.

ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἡμετέρῃσι: ἡμέτερος — our; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς), with χείρεσσιν
ἡφαίστοιο: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; by metonymy, fire; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)

ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.

ἥρῃ: Ἥρη — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. dat. sg. Ἥρῃ (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα)
ἥφαιστος: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; nom. sg.

ἰθὺς: ἰθύς — straight; adv. (epic = Attic εὐθύς): ’straight on’ · also prep. + gen.: ’straight towards’
ἰοχέαιρα: ἰοχέαιρα — arrow-pourer, shooter of arrows (epithet of Artemis); fem. nom. sg.
ἰοῦσα: εἶμι — go; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἴαχε: ἰάχω — cry out, resound, roar; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, of a loud natural noise

ἶσον: ἴσος — equal, like; neut. acc. sg.: ’equal’, or adverbial ’equally’ · also masc. acc. sg., + dat.: ’equal (to)’ (ὃν ἶσον ἐτίομεν ’whom we honoured as equal’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θυμόν: ’equal’ (ἶσον θυμὸν ἔχοντες ’with an equal spirit’)
ἶσος: ἴσος — equal, like (+ dat.); masc. nom. sg., epic ἶσος
ἷζε: ἵζω — sit down, take one’s seat; impf. 3 sg.: ’sat down’
ὀλύμπιοι: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian, dwelling on Olympus; masc. nom. pl.
ὀξὺ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg. · also used adverbially: ’sharply’ (ὀξὺ νόησε ’noticed sharply’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with βέλος: ’sharp (shaft)’
ὀρέων: ὄρος — mountain; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀρῶν)
ὀρυκτὴν: ὀρυκτός — dug (verbal adj. of ὀρύσσω); fem. acc. sg., agreeing with τάφρον
ὀτρύνοντες: ὀτρύνω — urge on, spur on, incite; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
ὁρόων: ὁράω — see, look; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὁρῶν)
ὁτὲ: ὁτέ (= τοτέ) — at one time, now; adv., correlative ὁτὲ μέν … ἄλλοτε δέ ’at one time … at another’
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἵππω πλήξαντε … βάλον ’until the two horses struck … and threw’) · also temporal, ’while’ + subj. in a general clause (ὄφρ’ εὕδῃσι ’while … sleeps’) · also temporal ’until, while’ + ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἀπόλοιτο ’so that he might perish’) · also temporal, ’while’ with ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἐγὼ … δύω ’while I put on’) · also temporal, ’until’ + aor. subj., without ἄν (ὄφρ’ ἀνέληται ’until she takes (him) up’) · also ὄφρα + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … ὤσαιτο ’so that he might drive back’)
ὅθ: ὅθι (elided ὅθ’) — where; relative adv. of place · also ὅτε (elided and aspirated ὅθ’) — when; temporal conj.
ὅμιλον: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. acc. sg.
ὅπῃ: ὅπῃ — where, whither, in whatever way; relative adv., also in an indirect question: ’how, in what way’
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὑπένερθεν: ὑπένερθε(ν) — below, beneath, from beneath; adv. in -θεν (Attic ὑποκάτω expresses the sense)
ὑπήλυθε: ὑπέρχομαι — go in under, creep beneath; aor. 3 sg., epic -ήλυθε (= Attic ὑπῆλθε): ’crept over’
ὑπερθύμοιο: ὑπέρθυμος — high-spirited (ὑπέρ + θυμός); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’) · also prep. + gen. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Πατρόκλοιο δαμῆναι ’to be subdued by Patroclus’) · also prep. + acc., place where: ’beneath’ (ὑπὸ γαῖαν ’beneath the earth’) · also prep. + φι-form of place: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ ζυγόφι ’from under the yoke’)
ὑψόθεν: ὑψόθεν — from on high, from above; adv., -θεν suffix
ὕπερθε: ὕπερθε(ν) — above, from above, on top; adv.
ὠκεανοῖο: Ὠκεανός — Ocean, the river encircling the earth; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὦρσεν: ὄρνυμι — rouse, raise up; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, with movable ν (= ὦρσε)
ὦρτο: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; mid./intr. aor. 3 sg. ὦρτο, root aorist: ’rushed, started up’ · also of a sound, aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’arose’
ὧν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. gen. pl. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: of whom, whose; gen. pl., partitive, not the possessive
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥέα: ῥέα — easily; adv., epic (= Attic ῥᾳδίως, ῥεῖα)
ῥήγνυντο: ῥήγνυμι — break; mid. break through; impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’broke through’
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥώοντο: ῥώομαι — move briskly, rush, sway; impf. 3 pl. mid. dep., epic: ’moved nimbly’
